title: Battelle analysis of 1947-1952 sightings

tellings.quote: But Battel put out a a very very deep analysis uh of of the 1947 and 1952 sightings. And guess what? Fascinating. Uh 33% of the most credible sightings were unknown.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Battelle, a private research institute, put out a very deep study of UFO sightings reported in the United States between 1947 and 1952. According to Michels, about a third of the most credible sightings in that study stayed unexplained. He points to it as a sign that the best cases could not be explained away.
